t_advice_summary_textbox.text: Try to figure out the highest scoring gnomes based on colour and hat shape. However this combination will change at some point so be aware.

vb_textbox.text: There will be four pairs of gnomes shown repeatedly. One gnome in each pair will yield more mushrooms than the other. Try to figure out which four gnomes yields the most mushrooms. These will occasionally change, so if one gnome starts giving fewer mushrooms, try the other one.
